name: ACT New Zealand
summary: Classical-liberal / libertarian-leaning party emphasising smaller government, personal responsibility, and market-oriented reform.

name: Alliance Party
summary: Democratic socialist party contesting 2026 after re-registration; focuses on tax justice, public ownership, and workers' rights.

name: Animal Justice Party Aotearoa New Zealand
summary: Animal-rights focused party advocating compassion, non-violence, sustainability, and a just transition away from animal exploitation.

name: Aotearoa Legalise Cannabis Party
summary: Single-issue-centred party campaigning for cannabis law reform including legal home grow.

name: Conservative Party NZ
summary: Socially conservative party on the 2026 party-vote ballot under the registered Conservative Party NZ name.

name: Free Palestine
summary: Registered list party focused on Palestinian justice, international law, and related foreign-policy demands in Aotearoa New Zealand.

name: Green Party
summary: Environmental and social-justice party with a large 2026 party list and published 2026 policy announcements.

name: Labour Party
summary: Centre-left major party; Chris Hipkins leads the 2026 party list.

name: National Party
summary: Centre-right major party currently in government; 2026 messaging emphasises fixing basics and building the future.

name: New Zealand First Party
summary: Nationalist / populist party led by Winston Peters; released its 2026 party list in October 2026.

name: New Zealand Loyal
summary: Re-registered for 2026; campaign materials centre on candidates and loyalty-to-New-Zealand messaging.

name: NZ Outdoors & Freedom Party
summary: Freedom-oriented party (ballot name remains NZ Outdoors & Freedom Party) emphasising direct democracy and civil liberties.

name: Opportunity Party
summary: Centrist / evidence-focused party (renamed from TOP) campaigning on unity, innovation, nature, and five coalition bottom lines.

name: Te Pati Maori
summary: Maori political party focused on mana motuhake and Te Tiriti; official 2026 party list lodged with one list candidate (Lance Norman), reflecting an electorate-centred strategy.

name: Te Tai Tokerau Party
summary: Newly registered 2026 party with a two-person official party list focused on Te Tai Tokerau.

name: Vision New Zealand
summary: Registered party led by Hannah Tamaki contesting the 2026 party vote with a six-person list.

name: Women's Rights Party
summary: Party focused on sex-based rights for women and girls, including positions on gender self-ID and youth medical transition.
